subject: maths
question: Find the area of a sector with an arc length of 44 cm, which subtends a central angle of 30°.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct relationship for the area of a sector: Area = ½ × L × r

Find the radius using the arc length formula: L = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

⇒ 44 = (30° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22/7) × r ⇒ r = 84 cm

⇒ Area = ½ × 44 × 84 = 1848 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1848 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Arc length (L) = 44 cm

Central angle (θ) = 30°

**Formula Used:**

Length of an arc = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

Area of a sector = ½ × L × r

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32688a9dbad9bf9f28a4f5a56289c97c5f7e34d44aba4fa4fc9d2c0487aa6ab9.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ L = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

⇒ 44 = (30° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22/7) × r

⇒ 44 = (1/12) × (44/7) × r

⇒ 1 = (1/12) × (1/7) × r

⇒ r = 12 × 7

⇒ r = 84 cm

Now, substitute the value of the radius into the area formula:

⇒ Area = ½ × L × r

⇒ Area = ½ × 44 × 84

⇒ Area = 22 × 84

⇒ Area = 1848 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1848 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area can also be calculated directly using the central angle: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Length of an Arc

The arc length is directly proportional to the central angle subtended: L = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total boundary length includes the arc length plus two times the radius: Perimeter = L + 2r.
